item.subject: Moving Tuesday's check-in?
item.body:
Hi Maya,

An LP meeting just landed on top of our Tuesday 2pm check-in. Could we move it to Wednesday (Sep 30) at 3pm instead? Same 30 minutes. Still keen to see the Q3 numbers beforehand.

Thanks,
Priya

# Priya Raman

GP at Harbor Point Ventures; led our $3.2M seed (Mar 2025) and is leading the seed extension
([[projects/seed-extension]]). Sits on our board.

- Wants a short written update before every check-in — bullets, numbers first.
- Assistant: Cam (cam@harborpoint.vc) schedules for her.
- Allergic to vanity metrics; cares about weekly active debuggers and retention.

## Next
- Check-in Tue Sep 29, 2:00pm. Send the Q3 update draft by Monday night.
